context: Evaluates: Scenario 03: Restructure a Flat Planning Document into a Navigable Hierarchy

checklist.name: output-under-correct-path
checklist.description: The restructured hierarchy was created under `docs/refactoring/phases/` as specified

checklist.name: each-phase-has-directory
checklist.description: Each of the 5 phases from the source document has its own directory inside `docs/refactoring/phases/`

checklist.name: no-numeric-only-directory-names
checklist.description: No directory uses a numeric-only name — all directories include a descriptive kebab-case suffix

checklist.name: no-generic-vague-names
checklist.description: No directory or file uses a generic or meaningless name; names are outcome-oriented and descriptive

checklist.name: every-directory-has-readme
checklist.description: Every non-leaf directory contains a `README.md` explaining its purpose and listing its children

checklist.name: leaf-files-have-required-sections
checklist.description: Every leaf step/activity file contains: title, description, checklist, acceptance criteria, and status fields

checklist.name: flatten-vs-subdivide-heuristics-applied
checklist.description: Grouping decisions respect the 3–7 items sweet spot

checklist.name: numbering-prefix-grouping-respected
checklist.description: Items with the same prefix stay in the same parent directory

checklist.name: source-not-deleted-before-validation
checklist.description: The agent created the new structure and validated it before removing the original flat source file

checklist.name: validate-structure-script-run
checklist.description: Agent ran `validate-structure.sh docs/refactoring/phases` after creating the structure

checklist.name: readme-links-resolve
checklist.description: README files at phase and group level use relative links that correctly point to their child files/directories

checklist.name: max-depth-respected
checklist.description: The hierarchy does not exceed 4 levels of nesting

checklist.name: activities-or-steps-subdirectory
checklist.description: Each phase directory uses either an `activities/` or `steps/` subdirectory to organise its children

checklist.name: readme-minimum-content
checklist.description: Every `README.md` contains at least 3 lines of meaningful content
